name: Omaha
seo_title: Omaha Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 29 Events, 12 Free
seo_description: Christmas events for kids in Omaha, Nebraska for 2026: 29 family events, 12 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Omaha for 2026, and here is what he found: 29 family events across Omaha and Bennington, 12 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Bright Nights at Lauritzen Gardens, the Tree Lighting Ceremony at The Durham Museum and Zoolightful at Omaha's Henry Doorly Zoo and Aquarium) through January 10, 2027 (Zoolightful), with the Holiday Lights Festival Lighting Ceremony (November 28), the Elkhorn Christmas Card Town tree lighting and parade (December 4 and 5), The Nutcracker by American Midwest Ballet (December 4 to 6) and Pancakes with Santa at Lauritzen Gardens (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Omaha

  • 29 Christmas events for kids in Omaha, including 1 from Bennington
  • 12 free events, including the Holiday Lights Festival Lighting Ceremony and Displays, Season of Lights at Midtown Crossing, Midwest Fest Holiday Market at Heartwood Preserve, Santa in the Village at Rockbrook Village, Ralston's Holiday Magic, the Elkhorn tree lighting and parade, Christmas in Olde Towne Elkhorn and the New Year's Eve Fireworks and Drone Show
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Magic at Omaha Children's Museum, Santa's Cabin Experience at The Durham Museum, Pancakes with Santa at Lauritzen Gardens, Santa in the Village at Rockbrook Village, Zoolightful at Omaha's Henry Doorly Zoo and Aquarium and Family Nights with Santa at The Durham Museum
  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas Card Town Tree Lighting and Parade in Elkhorn (December 4 and 5), the Holiday Lights Festival Lighting Ceremony (November 28) and the Tree Lighting Ceremony at The Durham Museum (November 27)
  • Shows: A Christmas Carol and A Charlie Brown Christmas at Omaha Community Playhouse, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer at The Rose Theater, The Nutcracker by American Midwest Ballet and the Omaha Symphony Christmas Celebration
  • Season: November 27 to January 10, 2027
